word: Title: Afternoon At The Community Center
I cut fabric for the decorations.
You cross the hallway to get markers. [pl]
We cover the tables with bright cloths.
They dedicate the afternoon to preparing the event.
answer: "Dedican la tarde a preparar el evento."

word: I define the roles for each volunteer.
You leave the finished posters on the counter. [sing, inf]
answer: "Dejas los carteles terminados en el mostrador."

word: We depend on everyone arriving on time.
answer: "Dependemos de que todos lleguen a tiempo."

word: They describe the plan to the new helpers.
answer: "Describen el plan a los nuevos ayudantes."

word: You discover a missing box of supplies. [sing, formal]
answer: "Descubre una caja de materiales que falta."

word: We determine the order of the activities.
They cast out old decorations we don’t need.
I elaborate a simple welcome sign.
You use the tape to hang the banner. [pl]
answer: "Emplean la cinta para colgar la manta."

word: We confront a small issue with the lights.
answer: "Enfrentamos un pequeño problema con las luces."

word: They show the new layout to the coordinator.
You avoid placing tables near the door. [sing, inf]
answer: "Evitas poner mesas cerca de la puerta."

word: I exist on the list of volunteers.
We express excitement for the event.
They skip one decoration because of time.
answer: "Faltan a una decoración por falta de tiempo."

word: You post the schedule on the main board. [sing, formal]
answer: "Fija el horario en el tablero principal."

word: We sign the attendance sheet.
They form small groups to help.
You work well with the sound system. [pl]
answer: "Funcionan bien con el sistema de sonido."

word: I win a small thank‑you gift.
We guarantee everything will be ready.
They are going to describe the event to visitors.
answer: "Van a describir el evento a los visitantes."

word: You are going to cut more fabric soon. [sing, inf]
We are going to celebrate after the event.
